feature_name: Google-managed OAuth client support for Google Sheets connector
summary: The Google Sheets connector can use a Google-managed OAuth client instead of a customer-created client.
extended_definition: The Google Sheets connector can use a Google-managed OAuth client instead of a customer-created client.
